verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: all the text is crammed into the top third and pushed against the left edge, the white frame is left as an empty box floating in the middle, the candles shrink to a tiny icon jammed into the bottom-left corner, and the rotated date is stranded at the bottom. B keeps the frame, the reading order (intro, church name, date, contact, candles) and the candle illustration at a good size. Its flaws: the intro wraps to an orphaned 'WEEKEND' line, the rotated date in the narrow column is small and hard to read, and the contact block is set tight and near the edge.
